title: A final class cannot pass an is_subclass_of guard

ground_truth.statement: FinalItem has no subclasses; is_subclass_of also excludes the class itself. Therefore construct always throws before the annotated new expression. The control checks the class itself and unrelated classes; finality supplies the universal argument.

provenance.note: Source suppresses UnnecessaryVarAnnotation and annotates consistent construction. Removed suppressions, retained final class, subclass guard, local @var and dynamic new. The important hidden fact is that the success branch is unreachable.

notes: No tool reports the impossible subclass condition. PHPStan is silent; Mago reports redundant-docblock-type at line 7; Psalm reports UnsafeInstantiation at line 8, claiming child constructors might change even though the class is final and this branch is unreachable. The latter two remain mixed against the impossible-condition baseline, not hidden by allowed predicates. Mago's redundant annotation warning is a policy difference, not a claim of a runtime defect. This cannot demonstrate successful dynamic construction.
